page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system configuration includes 372.0 GB of RAM, which yields approximately 3.88 GB of memory per physical core. Parallel processing capabilities are supported by four NVIDIA T4 GPUs from the Turing architecture family, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM.

This instance does not feature any local SSD or HDD storage, meaning all data persistence relies on external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, facilitating data transfer between the compute nodes and external storage or services.

Performance benchmarks indicate a pronounced tradeoff between single-threaded and multi-threaded execution. Single-core CPU performance ranks in the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. In contrast, multi-core CPU performance and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression both rank in the top 25%. Cached memory bandwidth for small blocks is strong, while uncached large-block read and write operations perform at average levels. Redis SET operations demonstrate high throughput, placing in the top 25% of tested configurations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high resource density for parallelized workloads by bundling four enterprise-grade GPUs with a high count of dedicated physical cores. This hardware profile is designed for parallel computing tasks, including machine learning inference, video transcoding, multi-threaded database operations, and high-throughput web serving.
